description: This file contains unit tests for the SubjectModified class, which is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.policies package. The tests verify immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception handling scenarios.

classes.name: SubjectModifiedTest
classes.description: A test class for unit testing the SubjectModified class, including immutability, equality, toJson, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that SubjectModified instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of equals and hashCode implementations using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating SubjectModified with a null policy ID string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Tests that creating SubjectModified with a null PolicyId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullLabel
methods.description: Tests that creating SubjectModified with a null Label throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullSubject
methods.description: Tests that creating SubjectModified with a null Subject throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method returns the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating a SubjectModified instance from a valid JSON string and verifies its fields.
